test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (Quant) (Held On: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: maths
question: Vipul and Manish invested the sum of Rs. 15000 and Rs. 20000 at the rate of 20 percent p.a and 30 percent p.a. respectively on compound interest (compounding annually). If time period is 3 years for both, then what will be the total compound interest earned by Vipul and Manish ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net effective compound interest rate for 3 years at 20% = 72.8%

Net effective compound interest rate for 3 years at 30% = 119.7%

CI of Vipul = 72.8% of 15000 = 10920

CI of Manish = 119.7% of 20000 = 23940

Total Compound Interest = 10920 + 23940 = 34860

**∴ The correct answer is ₹34860.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Vipul: Principal (P₁) = ₹15000, Rate (R₁) = 20%, Time (T) = 3 years

Manish: Principal (P₂) = ₹20000, Rate (R₂) = 30%, Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest (CI) = P[(1 + R/100)T − 1]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff1c06e99de2808f93af5b3c06570a8e9e72c72c981fcb9d1cc58defbb3059d2.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ CIVᵢₚᵤₗ = 15000 × [(1 + 20/100)³ − 1]

⇒ CIVᵢₚᵤₗ = 15000 × [(6/5)³ − 1]

⇒ CIVᵢₚᵤₗ = 15000 × [216/125 − 1] = 15000 × [91/125]

⇒ CIVᵢₚᵤₗ = 120 × 91 = ₹10920

⇒ CIMₐₙᵢₛₕ = 20000 × [(1 + 30/100)³ − 1]

⇒ CIMₐₙᵢₛₕ = 20000 × [(1.3)³ − 1]

⇒ CIMₐₙᵢₛₕ = 20000 × [2.197 − 1] = 20000 × 1.197

⇒ CIMₐₙᵢₛₕ = ₹23940

⇒ Total CI = 10920 + 23940 = 34860

**∴ The correct answer is ₹34860.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Method

For compound interest, net rate for 2 years = x + y + (xy/100). For 3 years, apply this twice.

CI vs SI for 3 Years

Difference (D) = P(R/100)² × (3 + R/100).

Effective Rates for 3 Years

10% p.a. = 33.1% | 20% p.a. = 72.8% | 5% p.a. = 15.7625%.
